lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base to +e2 leg fold, about 91 deg. My perpendicular sections at 2/25/50/75% put the label on the outer-skin apex (offset along the bisector -0.07/-0.01/0.00/-0.02 mm; nearest point 0.01-0.11 mm). The outer apex is present along the line from t=-1 to 122 mm, from the end-wall corner to the open +e1 end. The line runs 0-121.6 mm, so it covers about 98% and stays parallel.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base to -e2 leg fold, about 91 deg, mirrors B1. Sections at 2/25/50/75% give offsets of -0.03/+0.02/0.00/-0.04 mm, and the apex profile stays within 0.06 mm from t=5 to 115. The fold is visible over t=-1 to 122 mm and the line covers 0-121.4 mm, about 98%.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Base to end-wall fold at the -e1 end, about 90 deg. Sections at 2/25/50/75% give offsets of -0.11/-0.03/-0.01/0.00 mm. The face-on close-up shows the fold running between the two corner relief notches, about t=-1.5 to 37.5 mm, and the line spans 0-35.9 mm, about 92%. It is parallel to the fold.
